title: Positivity of the restriction rate
statement: Let $d,s$ be nonnegative integers and let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, with $s>1$. Define $W=\lceil\log_2(16s/\varepsilon)\rceil$ and $L=\lceil\log_2(24s/\varepsilon)\rceil$. Then $\frac{1}{10W}\left(\frac{1}{10L}\right)^{d-2}>0$, where the exponent uses truncated subtraction, so $d-2=\max(d-2,0)$.
